mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM wechat_identity WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND openid = #{openId}
SELECT user_id FROM wechat_identity WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE teacher_binding_code SET consumed_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_session (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_session SET revoked_at = #{now} WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(teacher_id, 2) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1 FROM app_user
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(student_code, 2) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1 FROM student
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO student_training_goal (student_id, goal_id, initial_level, current_level, phase, status) SELECT #{studentId}, id, 'C', 'C', 1, 'NOT_STARTED' FROM training_goal WHERE goal_type = 'STANDARD'
INSERT INTO app_user (teacher_id, name, school, position, role) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{teacherName}, #{school}, #{position}, #{role})

INSERT INTO student (student_code, name, gender, age, class_name, disability_type, remark, social_adaptation, self_management, cognitive_level, language_comprehension, expression_ability, hobbies) VALUES (#{studentCode}, #{studentName}, #{studentGender}, #{studentAge}, #{studentClassName}, #{disabilityType}, #{studentRemark}, #{socialAdaptation}, #{selfManagement}, #{cognitiveLevel}, #{languageComprehension}, #{expressionAbility}, #{hobbies})
INSERT INTO app_user_current_student (user_id, student_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{studentId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE student_id = VALUES(student_id)
